episodes.title: Do Not Go to the Castle
episodes.description: A young lawyer ignores every warning on his way to Castle Dracula.

scenes.narration: The villagers begged him not to go.
scenes.visual: Frightened villagers crowding around a young traveller in a candlelit mountain inn

scenes.narration: Jonathan Harker, a young English solicitor, had come to Transylvania on business.
scenes.visual: Jonathan stepping off a coach in a misty Carpathian village square at dusk

scenes.narration: A nobleman, Count Dracula, wanted to buy a house in London.
scenes.visual: A wax-sealed letter with a dark crest lying on a map of London

scenes.narration: At the inn, an old woman pressed a crucifix into his hand.
scenes.visual: An old peasant woman pressing a small silver crucifix into Jonathan's palm

scenes.narration: Tonight, she whispered, evil things walk the earth.
scenes.visual: Extreme close-up of an old woman's frightened eyes lit by firelight

scenes.narration: At midnight, a black carriage met him at the mountain pass.
scenes.visual: A black four-horse carriage waiting on a snowy mountain pass under a full moon

scenes.narration: Its tall driver had a grip of steel and eyes that glowed red.
scenes.visual: A tall cloaked coachman holding the reins, face in shadow, eyes glowing red

scenes.narration: Wolves howled in the dark forest all around them.
scenes.visual: A pack of wolves with glowing eyes among dark pine trees in moonlight

scenes.narration: Then the driver raised one arm, and the wolves fell silent.
scenes.visual: The coachman raising a pale hand as wolves cower in a ring around the carriage

scenes.narration: Jonathan would soon learn who that driver really was.
scenes.visual: The carriage disappearing up a winding road toward a huge dark castle on a cliff

episodes.title: No Reflection
episodes.description: Jonathan meets his host, and notices something impossible in the mirror.

scenes.narration: Last time, a strange coachman delivered Jonathan to the castle.
scenes.visual: A vast ruined castle on a cliff edge under a full moon, a carriage at its gate

scenes.narration: Count Dracula greets him at the door, a tall old man dressed all in black.
scenes.visual: A tall old nobleman holding an antique oil lamp in an arched stone doorway

scenes.narration: His hand is ice cold, and his grip is shockingly strong.
scenes.visual: Close-up of a pale clawlike hand gripping a younger man's hand

scenes.narration: He never eats, and Jonathan never sees him in daylight.
scenes.visual: Jonathan dining alone at a long candlelit table while the Count watches from the shadows

scenes.narration: One morning, shaving at a small mirror, Jonathan feels a hand on his shoulder.
scenes.visual: Jonathan shaving at a small mirror beside a window in pale morning light

scenes.narration: The Count stands right behind him, but the mirror shows an empty room.
scenes.visual: A small hand mirror reflecting only Jonathan and an empty room behind him

scenes.narration: The razor slips, and a drop of blood runs down his chin.
scenes.visual: Close-up of a thin trickle of blood on a young man's chin, razor in hand

scenes.narration: The Count's eyes blaze, and he lunges for Jonathan's throat.
scenes.visual: The Count lunging forward with blazing red eyes and clawed hands

scenes.narration: His hand brushes the crucifix, and he recoils as if burned.
scenes.visual: The Count recoiling from a small glowing crucifix on Jonathan's chest

scenes.narration: That night, Jonathan tries the castle doors. Every single one is locked.
scenes.visual: Jonathan pulling at a heavy iron-bound locked door in a dark stone corridor

episodes.title: The Three Sisters
episodes.description: Jonathan sees the Count crawl down a wall, then meets the castle's other residents.

scenes.narration: Last time, Jonathan discovered he was a prisoner in the castle.
scenes.visual: Jonathan peering from a high castle window at night

scenes.narration: One night, he sees the Count climb out of a window below.
scenes.visual: A dark figure emerging from a castle window far below, moonlight on the stone

scenes.narration: Head first, the Count crawls down the sheer castle wall like a lizard.
scenes.visual: The Count crawling face-down down a sheer stone wall, cloak spread like bat wings

scenes.narration: Desperate, Jonathan explores and finds a wing left unlocked.
scenes.visual: Jonathan entering a dusty moonlit room full of old furniture

scenes.narration: Against the Count's warning, he falls asleep there.
scenes.visual: Jonathan asleep on an old couch in a shaft of moonlight

scenes.narration: He wakes to three pale women standing over him.
scenes.visual: Three pale women in flowing white gowns standing over a sleeping man

scenes.narration: Their teeth gleam as one bends slowly toward his throat.
scenes.visual: Close-up of a pale woman with sharp gleaming teeth leaning down

scenes.narration: Then the Count storms in, furious, and hurls her back.
scenes.visual: The Count furious, eyes blazing, flinging the women away from the couch

scenes.narration: This man belongs to me, he snarls.
scenes.visual: Close-up of the Count's snarling face, eyes burning red

scenes.narration: When I am finished with him, he tells them, you may have him.
scenes.visual: The three women smiling hungrily in the dark as Jonathan lies frozen in fear

episodes.title: The Box of Earth
episodes.description: Jonathan finds where the Count sleeps by day, and learns he is heading for London.

scenes.narration: Last time, the Count saved Jonathan, but only for himself.
scenes.visual: The Count standing in a dark doorway, watching Jonathan

scenes.narration: Jonathan watches workers load fifty great wooden boxes onto wagons.
scenes.visual: Workmen loading large wooden crates onto horse wagons in a castle courtyard

scenes.narration: Each box is filled with earth from the castle grounds.
scenes.visual: Close-up of an open wooden crate filled with dark soil

scenes.narration: He climbs down the outer wall himself to find the Count's room.
scenes.visual: Jonathan climbing barefoot down the outside of the castle wall above a deep gorge

scenes.narration: A passage leads to a ruined chapel and an open box.
scenes.visual: A ruined chapel crypt, broken stone, an open wooden box in a shaft of light

scenes.narration: Inside lies the Count, looking younger, his lips wet with fresh blood.
scenes.visual: The Count lying in a box of earth, eyes open, blood on his lips

scenes.narration: Horrified, Jonathan raises a shovel and strikes.
scenes.visual: Jonathan raising a shovel over the open box in the dark crypt

scenes.narration: The Count's head turns, and his dead eyes stare straight at him.
scenes.visual: Extreme close-up of the Count's staring red eyes

scenes.narration: Days later, the boxes are nailed shut and carted away to the sea.
scenes.visual: Crates nailed shut on a wagon heading down a winding mountain road

scenes.narration: And Jonathan is left behind, alone with the three women.
scenes.visual: Jonathan at a window as three pale figures appear in the dark corridor behind him

episodes.title: Meanwhile, in England
episodes.description: In a seaside town, Mina and Lucy have no idea what is coming.

scenes.narration: Last time, the Count's boxes of earth left for England.
scenes.visual: A cargo ship sailing out of a misty harbour at dawn

scenes.narration: In England, Jonathan's fiancée, Mina, waits for letters that never come.
scenes.visual: Mina writing a letter at a window in a seaside town

scenes.narration: She is staying with her best friend, Lucy, in the seaside town of Whitby.
scenes.visual: Two young women walking on a clifftop above a harbour town with a ruined abbey

scenes.narration: Lucy has just received three marriage proposals in a single day.
scenes.visual: Lucy laughing, holding three letters fanned out in her hand

scenes.narration: A doctor, a Texan adventurer, and Arthur Holmwood, the man she loves.
scenes.visual: Three men in Victorian clothes standing side by side in a drawing room

scenes.narration: She says yes to Arthur.
scenes.visual: Arthur kneeling before Lucy in a sunlit garden

scenes.narration: But at night, Lucy has begun to sleepwalk.
scenes.visual: Lucy in a white nightgown walking with closed eyes down a dark hallway

scenes.narration: Mina locks their bedroom door and hides the key.
scenes.visual: Mina turning a key in a bedroom door, candle in her other hand

scenes.narration: Out at sea, a terrible storm is rising.
scenes.visual: Huge waves crashing against cliffs, lightning over a black sea

scenes.narration: And a Russian ship is being driven straight toward Whitby.
scenes.visual: A sailing ship tossed by a storm, heading toward a harbour
